# PureFlow Air & Chimney

> Independent lead referral service connecting Houston-area homeowners
> with licensed local providers for air duct, dryer vent, and chimney services.
> PureFlow does not perform the work itself.

## Services

- [Air Duct Cleaning](https://www.pureflow-services.com/#pricing): from $299
- [Chimney Sweep & Inspection](https://www.pureflow-services.com/#pricing): from $149
- [Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://www.pureflow-services.com/#pricing): from $99

## How it works

1. Free phone quote, answered 24/7
2. On-site visit by a licensed local provider — $29
3. Written quote before any work begins; you approve or decline

If the quote is declined, only the $29 visit fee applies.
The visit fee and job pricing are set and charged by the matched provider.

## Service area

Greater Houston, Texas — approximately 45 miles from the city.
Includes Houston, Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Pearland,
Cypress, Spring, Pasadena, Humble, Tomball, Conroe.
